queries.name: ToolGuard failed calls by tool
queries.query: SELECT data_toolName, count(*) AS failures FROM toolguard_logs WHERE event_type = 'tool.call.failed' GROUP BY data_toolName ORDER BY failures DESC
queries.purpose: Identify bounded demo tools that failed under ToolGuard mediation.

queries.name: ToolGuard failure type trend
queries.query: SELECT event_type, count(*) AS events FROM toolguard_logs WHERE level = 'error' GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY events DESC
queries.purpose: Summarize error-level ToolGuard events without exposing raw payloads.

queries.name: ToolGuard sanitized outputs
queries.query: SELECT run_id, trace_id, tool_call_id, message FROM toolguard_logs WHERE event_type = 'output.sanitized' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC
queries.purpose: Show redaction and prompt-injection sanitization evidence.

queries.name: ToolGuard run drilldown
queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, level, event_type, trace_id, tool_call_id, message FROM toolguard_logs WHERE run_id = '<runId>' ORDER BY _timestamp ASC
queries.purpose: Inspect all redacted logs for one deterministic demo run.

queries.name: ToolGuard trace waterfall
queries.query: SELECT trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, name, start_time, end_time FROM toolguard_traces WHERE trace_id = '<traceId>' ORDER BY start_time ASC
queries.purpose: Follow one tool call through ToolGuard policy, execution, retry, and evidence events.

queries.name: ToolGuard circuit opens
queries.query: SELECT run_id, trace_id, tool_call_id, message FROM toolguard_logs WHERE event_type = 'circuit.opened' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC
queries.purpose: Show circuit-breaker protection when failures repeat.

queries.name: ToolGuard retry events
queries.query: SELECT run_id, trace_id, tool_call_id, message FROM toolguard_logs WHERE event_type LIKE 'retry.%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC
